comment.comment:
here are my raw thoughts on mihao (🥷)

ive been in this spot a few times now, finding something relatively early, buying with solid size, and suddenly being up 6 figures

usually that happens by not paying attention to price, having the patience to hold, and a lot of luck

specifically, wif, pepe, ordinals, pups, and fwog. these i held for months (sometimes years) and through it, learned the power of diamond handing

you had a thesis, and you let it fully play out, sometimes stomaching 50% drawdowns without blinking

it was a phase where i learned how to break my brain, and was greatly rewarded for it

now the questions become, "HOW do you hold that long?" and "HOW do you know if something is worth holding?"

the first is very hard, but for me it's always been:

> logging off and doing anything but trading
> consistently taking small profits, rewarding yourself for holding
> zooming out and revisiting your thesis
> dont click buttons

sometimes it works out, sometimes it doesn't. that's why i've learned to constantly sliver out while keeping a significant moonbag. it's a delicate balance

now the second question, "is what you're holding worth it?"

in this moment, i really do like mihao, for the same reasons that made me first buy it

> community strong af, raids hard across all socials
> viral across all socials
> mihao is aesthetic, has international aura
> great mix of holders, notable people, traders, and support from brands

however, with all of that, this market is tricky

youve seen me hold similar positions on cyberleek and zipcoin publicly. i've taken profits, but over time have been punished for diamond handing

whether that's because of the current environment, the behavior of traders, shorter attention spans, or other factors, i don't know

but it's been a while since i've been punished for taking profit or selling

so that's why im playing mihao exactly as i am

taking profit here and there to 1) be able to hold longer and 2) adapt to the new environment

will holders be rewarded once again? maybe. i hope so, and that's why i carry a significant moonbag

but im also protecting myself in the trade and allowing myself to sleep well at night in peace

i love this meme and havent felt like this in a while

it carries a lot of memetic energy, and ive always been drawn to that

hopefully these raw thoughts help people see my thought process and learn from it too
